title: Manager - Legal (Auto)
description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

As a Manager - Legal (Auto) at Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the company's legal framework, specialising in the automotive sector. Your primary responsibilities will encompass drafting and vetting a comprehensive range of commercial agreements, including Development and Supply Agreements, Master Service Agreements, Related Party Transactions (RPT) Agreements, Distributor and Dealer Agreements. You will also be responsible for reviewing and drafting legal documents related to intellectual property rights, such as Technology Licenses, Domain Name Licenses, Assignment Deeds, and Software License Agreements.

In addition, you will advise cross-functional business teams on compliance and legal queries associated with the Information Technology Act, Data Protection and Privacy laws, Automotive Research Association of India (ARAI) regulations, marketing, and sales practices. Providing timely and practical legal counsel on day-to-day operational matters will be a key part of your role.

You will liaise with internal stakeholders and external legal advisors to ensure that all legal documentation supports the company's strategic objectives while mitigating risk. This role requires a commitment to delivering high-quality, clear, and effective legal deliverables within stringent timelines. You will also contribute to the continuous improvement of legal processes and templates, while championing diligent documentation and record-keeping practices.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Educational and Professional Qualifications:**

* A Bachelor of Laws degree (LLB) followed by a Master of Laws degree (LLM) from a recognised university.

**Experience:**

* A minimum of 7 to 10 years of combined experience working in top-tier law firms and in-house legal teams, preferably within the automotive or manufacturing sectors.
* Demonstrated expertise in contract law, corporate law, intellectual property rights, and regulatory compliance including data protection and technology laws.

**Skills and Attributes:**

* Exceptional legal drafting and negotiation skills with a meticulous eye for detail.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of conveying complex legal concepts in accessible language for diverse business audiences.
* Proactive, collaborative, and a strong team player who contributes positively to a dynamic, high-performance legal department.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities efficiently and deliver high-quality outputs within tight deadlines.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a commitment to ethical practice and confidentiality.

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
------------------------------------------------------

At Mahindra and Mahindra Limited, we believe that diversity drives innovation, and inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to cultivating a workplace where every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.
  
We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, caste, race, religion, color, ethnic origin, gender identity, nationality, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, educational background, marital or domestic partnership status, pregnancy or childbirth, veteran status, citizenship status, ancestry, financial status, or any other personal characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
We actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply and bring their unique perspectives to our teams. We are committed to ensuring an accessible and inclusive experience for all applicants.
  
Together, we rise by embracing differences and building a future that reflects the communities we serve.

**Job Segment:** Automotive

title: Senior Tax & Compliance Analyst - VCS
description:
What You'll Do:

The Senior Analyst, VCS plays a critical role in strengthening the accuracy, scalability, and AI-enabled execution of Avalara’s U.S. Voluntary Compliance Services (VCS) operations across multiple jurisdictions and complex client environments. As client complexity, historical exposure, and voluntary disclosure volumes increase, this role ensures consistent SLA performance, reduces compliance and penalty risk, and embeds AI-driven workflow improvements that enhance productivity and quality. This individual contributor is expected to operate as a Bar Raiser, elevating execution rigor, mentoring junior analysts, and applying AI in measurable ways to improve speed, insight, and operational scale across the VCS lifecycle (from transactional data intake and nexus validation through data manipulation, analysis, processing, and reporting of historical returns prepared for filing).
  
**#Hybrid**

What Your Responsibilities Will Be:

**How This Role Elevates Avalara**

* For Customers Delivers high-accuracy, on-time preparation of historical Sales & Use tax returns for filing — through data manipulation, analysis, processing, and reporting — across multiple jurisdictions, along with voluntary disclosure submissions, proactively mitigating exposure to penalties, interest, and audit risk.
* Acts as a senior point of contact for customers and their project managers, and as liaison with state taxing authorities for state voluntary disclosure / amnesty programs, providing clear status communication and documentation that help customers understand risk remediation and the outcome of their VCS engagements.
* For the Business Improves operational leverage by: Reducing manual effort in transactional data validation, reconciliation, pSTRA preparation, and notice handling.
* Standardizing VCS status, nexus, and exposure reporting. Accelerating turnaround for large historical scopes and complex multi-state disclosures.
* Supports margin and discount discipline by minimizing re-work, return revisions, and avoidable escalations.

**For the Team Raises talent density through:**

* Mentorship and coaching of juniors on VCS standards, nexus and exposure judgment, and client communication. Structured review and quality control discipline for voluntary compliance spreadsheets and historical returns.
* Sharing templates, SOPs, and AI-enabled best practices that uplift the whole team.
* For Our AI-First Strategy Improves turnaround time per voluntary disclosure / historical project.
* Increases accuracy and consistency across returns, disclosure spreadsheets, and periods. Raises analyst productivity and independence by leveraging AI-enabled workflows already defined for the team.

**Responsibilities (Outcome-Based Ownership)**

Own end-to-end preparation, processing, analysis, and quality assurance of historical Sales & Use tax data and returns for multi-period, multi-jurisdiction VCS engagements — including custom pSTRA, Tax Summary Reports, and voluntary compliance spreadsheets submitted to state taxing authorities — so returns are accurate and ready to be filed, delivering

* 99% accuracy and 98–100% on-time SLA adherence.
* Independently manage complex reconciliations and variance analysis between client transactional data, prior filings, and proposed disclosure returns, including altering or adding transaction data where required while maintaining clear audit trails.
* Serve as the senior primary point of contact for customers and their project managers, and as liaison with state taxing authorities for state voluntary disclosure / amnesty programs, owning sensitive negotiations and status conversations.
* Maintain a 24-hour turnaround time for critical client escalations and compliance inquiries related to voluntary disclosures, historical returns, notices, or exposure questions.
* Demonstrate deep understanding of complex, historical transaction-level data and U.S. Sales & Use tax law, ensuring data is accurately validated, troubleshot, transformed, and reported — including nexus setup — so historical returns and disclosures are prepared and ready to be filed.
* Improve document and data retrieval turnaround time by 15–25% using AI-supported research, pattern recognition, and tracking tools.
* Standardize weekly VCS status, nexus, risk, and exposure reporting using AI-enabled formatting and summarization tools.
* Identify and implement at least one scalable AI-enabled workflow enhancement within the first 6 months, with clear measurement of productivity or quality impact.
* Manage relationships with customers, project managers, state taxing authorities, and internal/external Avalara partners throughout the VCS lifecycle to ensure alignment on scope, timelines, risks, and outcomes, including proactive de-escalation through direct customer calls when needed.
* Mentor I1/I2 analysts in independent case handling, nexus and exposure analysis, high-quality documentation, client-ready narratives, and effective, compliant AI usage.
* Maintain and continuously improve SOP documentation for VCS (data intake, nexus validation, reconciliation, pSTRA preparation, disclosure submission, return preparation for filing, notice handling, and closeout) aligned to client contracts, jurisdictional rules, and Avalara standards.
* Provide proactive support to CAMs and Sales to help drive successful voluntary compliance and remediation sales cycles, including answering scoping questions, joining key client calls, and providing clear, data-backed delivery perspectives.

**AI Bar Raiser Expectations**

* The Senior Analyst, VCS must demonstrate exceptional applied AI capability that produces measurable operational impact, not just experimentation.
* This includes: Embedding AI tools into transactional data cleansing and enrichment, reconciliation and variance explanation, nexus and historical exposure summaries, pSTRA preparation, and VCS escalation workflows.
* Quantifying impact (e.g., time saved per engagement, reduction in manual review hours, improved turnaround time per disclosure period, fewer rework cycles).
* Applying AI responsibly while exercising professional judgment, especially for compliance-sensitive topics such as taxability, nexus determinations, exposure estimates, and final return values. Sharing AI best practices (prompts, workflows, validation steps) to elevate team capability and embed them into SOPs.
* Continuously identifying automation opportunities aligned to efficiency, risk reduction, scalability, and consistent client experience.
* Casual or convenience-based AI usage does not meet Avalara’s AI Bar Raiser standard.

**12-Month Success Signals**

Within 12 months, the Senior Analyst, VCS will demonstrate: Sustained

* 99% preparation accuracy across their VCS portfolio (returns prepared for filing, disclosure spreadsheets, amendments, and corrections).
* 98–100% on-time performance for agreed VCS SLAs, including during peak workload and complex multi-state disclosures.
* 15–25% reduction in document and data retrieval turnaround time through AI-enabled research, tracking, and templated requests.
* Measurable reduction in re-work and re-opened engagements via robust validation controls, better upstream scoping, and AI-supported checks.
* At least one implemented AI-driven workflow enhancement (e.g., automated variance narratives, pSTRA/template builders, data-mapping accelerators) delivering quantifiable productivity gains.
* Documented AI and process best practices adopted across the VCS team and incorporated into SOPs.
* Strong independent handling of complex escalations, including high-exposure periods, nuanced jurisdictional and nexus rules, and sensitive client and state-authority scenarios, with minimal senior intervention, including proactive de-escalation through direct client calls and clear, solution-focused communication.

What You'll Need to be Successful:

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Taxation, Finance, or related field; or MBA in Finance.
* 3–4+ years of U.S. indirect tax / Sales & Use tax compliance experience, ideally including voluntary disclosure, amnesty, or remediation programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-jurisdiction return portfolios and handling compliance escalations (e.g., notices, penalty and interest issues, nexus questions).
* Advanced MS Excel proficiency (complex formulas, pivot tables, macros/VBA, large data-set handling) and demonstrated ability to work with complex historical transaction data to prepare accurate disclosures and historical returns ready for filing.
* Proven experience using AI tools to improve operational speed, quality, or scale (for example, in data analysis, documentation, or reporting workflows).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex historical tax, nexus, and exposure topics in clear, client-friendly language to customers, project managers, and state taxing authorities.
* AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

Avalara is an AI-first Company:

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

  
What You Need To Know About Avalara:

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Assistant Vice President - Legal Discovery Management
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

**Job Title**
-------------


eDiscovery Operations – Sr Counsel

**Description**
---------------


Legal Discovery Management (LDM) is an internal organization within the firm's Litigation Department.


As a Senior Counsel in Legal discovery operations team you will support and facilitate the legal discovery process, including the identification, preservation, collection, review, and production of information relevant to litigation matters, regulatory inquiries, and internal investigations.


Duties will include but will not be limited to: performing custodial/data source research and identification, along with the preservation, collection, disposition, and/or secure delivery of data within pre\-defined Service Level Agreements; acting as liaison between LDM and its partners, participating in end\-to\-end eDiscovery projects and programs with a focus on process improvement; managing various projects with multiple stakeholders; coordinating project milestones and deliverables; working directly with all staff levels from analysts to senior management, and delivering results on both near\- and long\-term initiatives.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Act as a point\-of\-contact for legal teams, advising and coordinating discovery activities.
* Respond to and fulfill eDiscovery requests across various data sources, including but not limited to electronic communications, voice, structured and unstructured data sources.
* Coordinate the discovery lifecycle among all collaborating parties, including the firm's internal attorneys, outside counsel, vendors, and the firm's internal discovery IT group.
* Conduct early matter outreach, discovery planning, budgeting, custodian scoping, tracking, status reporting, managing to timelines and overseeing production requests.
* Coordinate with internal IT and business partners, and external vendors in support of request fulfillment, including restoration of data with appropriate chain\-of\-custody documentation, where required.
* Oversee day\-to\-day case details for certain matter types. Maintain a level of understanding of the business uses for the systems from which data is being requested and proactively address questions related to fulfilling such requests.
* Act as a liaison between the eDiscovery team and global systems and data center contacts, including but not limited to tape operations areas/data centers and third parties, to manage various legal discovery requests.
* Facilitate the flow of documents and knowledge throughout the discovery process: direct documents into the appropriate workstreams and transmit questions, answers, and information to/from the managed review vendor and internal or external counsel.
* Support the continuous improvement of eDiscovery operational processes globally, including request processing, research, preservation, collection, disposition, delivery, and control.
* Draft and/or review process management documentation, maintain organized updates and detailed matter/project notes and documentation.
* Data\-driven problem solving and decision making; manage and appropriately escalate delivery impediments, risks, issues, and changes associated with process enhancement initiatives.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
-----------------------------------------------------




* Law Graduate / J.D. from an accredited law school.  

Attorney must be licensed to practice law and a member in good standing in the state/jurisdiction in which the position is based or otherwise in compliance with the in\-house counsel registration rules of that state/jurisdiction.
* Minimum 5\+ years of discovery experience at a financial services provider, consulting firm, discovery vendor, or top\-tier law firm, with cross\-EDRM hands\-on and advisory experience.
* Understanding of firm change management processes and procedures (SDLC, etc.) and experience working in a secure environment with sensitive data, including PII.
* Familiarity with Electronically Stored Information ESI investigation procedures, preservation, disposition, recovery, and analysis of data from a variety of electronic communication, voice, and unstructured systems (e.g., M365 Purview, MS Exchange, Connected Archive, Lotus Notes, Robocopy, OnTrack, Hard Drives, Ascent, Digital Safe, NICE, Cisco, SharePoint), backup tape infrastructure (ArcServe, TSM, TDP, NetBackup), structured data systems, databases and/or EDRM (eDiscovery Reference Model), or litigation support\-related experience.
* Project Management, ITIL, ACEDS, PMP background.
* Familiarity with, knowledge of, or understanding of legal chain\-of\-custody requirements, regulatory processes, and basic Federal Rules of Civil Procedure.
* Self\-motivated, highly flexible, organized, and team\-oriented, with the ability to track multiple workstreams and manage confidential and/or sensitive, time\-critical, and competing priorities and projects. Comfortable responding to shifting priorities and working independently with minimal supervision.


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.  

  

With large, global operations, the Legal team tackles complex issues and helps shape the regulations that affect the businesses. The group is organized into practice groups that align with the lines of business and corporate staff areas, which encourages collaboration on legal, regulatory and business developments as they arise.
